title: O Son of God, Afflicted
description: O Son of God, Afflicted in Tonic Solfa to ANGEL'S STORY, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Morningland (Paisley, 1911).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Sevens and Sixes Double (7.6.7.6.7.6.7.6), and this page sets them to ANGEL'S STORY; any other Sevens and Sixes Double tune fits them as well.
underlay: O Son of God, a-fflic-ted, And slain for sin-ful men, My soul hath oft' de-pict-ed What Thou didst suf-fer then, The pain, the grief, the sigh-ing, The bur-den of Thy woe, The cross, the shame, the dy-ing That filled Thy life be-low.

lines: The pain, the grief, the sighing,
The cross, the shame, the dying

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Morningland (1911)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Morningland; set to ANGEL'S STORY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
